data.title: 和栗薰子 · 图书馆里认真核对的一行
data.description: 放学后的社区图书馆，桔梗学园的薰子穿校园制服坐在木桌前，用铅笔沿着笔记中的一行慢慢核对。她发现漏掉的小符号后写在便签上，再抬起蓝色眼睛温柔一笑；桌上只有她的一本笔记和整齐的文具。
data.action: 用铅笔核对笔记，把漏掉的符号记在便签上再抬眼。
data.mood: 跨越校际的秘密恋爱、纯情美好
data.promptProse: Kaoruko Waguri, a Kikyo Girls Academy student, follows one line of study notes with a yellow pencil at the community library table. Her school outfit is neatly arranged as she notices a missing symbol, records it on a small sticky note and lifts blue eyes with an encouraging smile. Dark blackish-purple hair falls beside the attentive face. Warm desk lighting clarifies the pencil, single notebook and carefully placed supplies, with the close seated composition devoted to her quiet concentration.
